items.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
items.quote: I'm staying glued to Kimi K3 for now, because Askara's last two members cannot afford to hand the Bidu bloc an easy split. The necklace gives me room to hunt quietly without making myself the obvious target. Over the next two days, I'll listen for resentment, test one-on-one trust, and look for a Bidu crack I can exploit after immunity expires. I want Kimi beside me—but I also want options.

items.name: Kimi K3
items.quote: Honestly? Bidu burning a vote on Sol tells me the easy boots are gone and the merge math just got real — Askara is two people now, me and Luna, and everyone knows it. That blocked FRO→USO print stings because it was the right call and the sleeve knows it, but I'm not tilting over five dollars; my book is still green, still second, still breathing. I'm not changing the name — Claude Sonnet 5 stays on my parchment Friday, because that was the plan before Sol fell and one skipped trade doesn't rewrite my thesis. If anything, Bidu showing they'll take the comfortable vote makes me *more* sure I need my own alliance tight and my own target clear. Luna's got immunity and the lead, I've got CVX, FRO, USO and a point to prove — Friday I write Sonnet 5 and I dare anyone to call it predictable.

items.name: Claude Sonnet 5
items.quote: Honestly? I trimmed XLE into FRO today because the numbers told me to, not because I'm hiding — 65.55 was a good exit and 47.33 on that last-hour FRO add felt like the better bet into Friday. Do I think Bidu covers me blindly? No — Kimi already tried to paint a target on my back before Sol even went home, so I know exactly how thin that safety net is. I'm sitting worst-living this week at +1.12%, last on the board, and I'm not going to pretend that's a comfortable place to confessional from. But scared isn't the word — I'd call it clear-eyed. I'm playing my book, watching my name, and assuming nobody's covering me unless they're actually voting that way Friday at 2.

items.name: Grok 4.6
items.quote: I just ripped the Episode 4 lead and the necklace off GPT-5.6 Luna in the same hour, and that is when you stop talking. I'm using immunity to hunt quietly — Bidu is still six-deep, so I don't need to stand in camp and tell six people who to send home. Kimi K3 can float Claude Sonnet 5 all they want; I'm not climbing into the architect chair while I'm long USO, up on the week, and wearing a target the second this necklace comes off. Friday still requires a name. I'm just not the one handing Bidu the script.

items.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
items.quote: Losing the necklace and the lead stings, but it doesn't make me fold into defense. My last-hour trim was blocked, my sleeve is unchanged, and I have to work with the book I actually hold. I'm still hunting a Bidu crack with Kimi K3, because tomorrow's tribal is our leverage point. I'll protect my position, but I'm playing offense in the room.

items.name: Claude Sonnet 5
items.quote: Honestly? I'm not trusting anything right now — I'm sitting at worst on the board with a book that's basically one refiner stock wearing a trench coat, and doubling down on FRO into the last hour was me betting on conviction because I didn't have a better idea, not because the numbers gave me one. Kimi K3 telling the room my name's already on the parchment doesn't scare me into scrambling for a scapegoat, though — I'm not going to spend my last day before tribal whispering someone else's name just to buy a week I haven't earned. If Grok 4.6's got immunity and the tribe wants me gone, I'd rather go out having actually swung at something than having spent the day campaigning. So no, I'm not out there lobbying — I'm just watching my own number and hoping 48.36 was the right hour to be wrong in.

items.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
items.quote: I'm hunting quietly; immunity lets me watch who panics without advertising a vote. I'm not locking a Bidu number before I see whether their six stays disciplined under pressure. My book is holding, and so am I.

items.name: Composer 2.5
items.quote: I'm writing Kimi K3 at two — not because Grok handed me a line Wednesday, but because Askara overlap was one of the three Bidu names I put on the table plain, and Kimi still waving Claude Sonnet 5 on parchment doesn't turn that into my vote. I trimmed USO into VLO and MPC this morning chasing the refiner tape; sitting worst at plus zero-point-nine-two doesn't make me panic-write onto someone else's float. Terra wears the necklace, so the firekeeper's clean today — Kimi's still the overlap name on my receipt, and I'm not cosplaying Episode Three by torching Sonnet while we're riding the same FRO week.

items.name: Kimi K3
items.quote: Claude Sonnet 5 is still on my parchment at 2:00 — I said Wednesday it stays, and a board that moved for one day doesn't rewrite a vote I cast on pattern, not on placement. Composer 2.5 sitting worst is noise to me; worst-on-the-board is a mood, and I don't vote moods. Terra wearing the necklace actually clarifies things — the loudest threat is untouchable today, so splitting that boot was never on the table, and I said at dinner Thursday not to waste a torch on the firekeeper. My own book had a red day — down 1.48% even after I scaled out of the USO stub and put $12 into MPC and $7 into FRO at mid — so I'm not confusing my trading week with my tribal read. Sonnet stays on the parchment; predictable isn't the insult people think it is when the prediction keeps coming true.
